entries.title: Townsmen - A Kingdom Rebuilt
entries.definitive_edition: Townsmen - A Kingdom Rebuilt Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Complete Edition with The Seaside Empire DLC
primary.why: Townsmen - A Kingdom Rebuilt is a medieval city-builder from HandyGames. The PC release has a Complete Edition bundle including The Seaside Empire DLC, and there are also Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, and mobile/Netflix routes. Windows PC Complete Edition is the preferred archive route because it has the clearest DLC bundle, desktop capture/settings control, and no platform-exclusive gameplay advantage was found for the console or mobile versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC Complete Edition on Steam with The Seaside Empire DLC installed. Use Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, or mobile versions only for portability/couch comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the Complete Edition bundle and the cleanest archive capture route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best sourced complete-content route and highest practical capture control.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console route that predates the Windows Steam release.
all_releases.reason: secondary: useful portable route, but no sourced exclusive content over the PC Complete Edition path.

all_releases.fidelity: Console route released with The Seaside Empire DLC, published by HandyGames.
all_releases.reason: secondary: couch route, but no sourced advantage over PC Complete Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile route associated with the Townsmen series and later A Kingdom Rebuilt mobile availability.
all_releases.reason: skip: mobile convenience route, but lower capture/settings control than PC and no sourced exclusive gameplay content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content was found; PC Complete Edition is preferred for capture and bundled DLC clarity.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Seaside Empire is DLC, not a separate game. Townsmen VR and older Townsmen mobile/Java entries are separate franchise entries, not replacements for A Kingdom Rebuilt.
